text:
nina_ops: Kicking a controlled rollout for v2.0.9-hotfix (US -> EU -> APAC). Start small: US 3% for 10m, then EU 10%, APAC delayed by maintenance. Watch thermal and token-cost spikes.

deploy-bot: Preflight (us): gpus free=20/24, kv primed, smoke p95=86ms, errors=0.03%. warmup=10m.

omar: FYI EU has an infra drain scheduled on node-b12 in 30m; recommend reserving 2 warm nodes before scaling.

rachel_p: Noted. Policy: rollback if p95>190ms OR error-rate>0.5% for 3m. Full-pin target: v2.0.8-stable.

sylvia: Observability: enable trace sampling x3 for first 15m and set cost-alert at +35% baseline. Slack hook to this thread for "deploy:rollback-signal".

deploy-bot: EU preflight: gpus free=8/10 (2 reserved), kv hit=76%, p95=165ms, errors=0.14%. ready to slice.

nina_ops: Starting EU to 10% in 5m. APAC hold until maintenance clears (+20m buffer).

rachel_p: Manual rollback command for folks: ```./infra/deployctl rollback --region $REGION --to v2.0.8 --note "ops/auto"```

omar: If EU p95 creeps >175ms for 2m, auto-stepdown to 6% to avoid hitting trigger. Implementing now.

deploy-bot: US stable at 3% for 12m. EU scaled to 10% -> p95 172ms -> hit 2m window. Auto-stepdown to 6% executed.

sylvia: After stepdown p95 down to 142ms. Holding. Will run a quick quality eval on checkout_flow promptset.

nina_ops: APAC maintenance cleared early. Recommend gentle start at 4% in 10m with burst nodes reserved. If any region crosses rollback rule, we pin globally to v2.0.8 and notify support.

rachel_p: I'll post release note to #support: v2.0.9-hotfix staged rollout (perf & stability fixes). Rollback triggers and pin info included.

nina_ops: Great teamwork. I'll close thread once APAC stable at 15% for 10m. :white_check_mark:
